frictions.description: The app appears to use Vite's hot module reload (HMR) which causes frequent page reloads during development. This breaks browser automation as the browser session loses context and refs become invalid.
frictions.resolution: Attempted multiple strategies: reloading page, using semantic locators, chaining commands - all failed due to HMR

frictions.description: Form field interactions frequently timed out even when elements were visible in snapshots. The agent-browser fill() and click() commands often failed with timeout errors.
frictions.resolution: Tried using focus() + keyboard inserttext() which worked occasionally but was unreliable

frictions.description: Console shows warnings about localStorage fallback (Failed to load settings from backend, Failed to add proxy via Tauri) - this is expected in browser mode but should be noted
frictions.resolution: Warnings are expected behavior when running in browser without Tauri backend

blockers.description: Vite hot module reload (HMR) causes page reloads every few seconds, breaking browser automation flow and invalidating element refs. This makes it impossible to complete multi-step UI testing flows.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Attempted to work around by reloading page, using semantic locators, and chaining commands - all strategies failed due to HMR timing

blockers.description: Browser automation commands (fill, click) frequently timed out even when elements were visible and interactable in snapshots. This suggests the app may have rendering or state management issues that prevent reliable automation.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Tried focus + keyboard inserttext as alternative, but was unreliable

summary: Attempted to test 5 assertions but all were blocked by technical issues: Vite hot module reload causes frequent page reloads that break browser automation, and form field interactions frequently timed out. Only partial testing was possible: I was able to navigate to the Proxy tab, enable the proxy toggle, and observe the UI structure. However, I could not reliably complete multi-step flows like adding proxies and verifying they appeared in the list. Recommendation: Disable HMR for user testing sessions, or use a more stable testing approach (e.g., production build, or manual testing with human observer).
